name: std::span<T,Extent>::first

declarations.code:
template <std::size_t Count>

constexpr std::span<element_type, Count> first() const;
constexpr std::span<element_type, std::dynamic_extent> first(size_type Count) const;

intro: Obtains a span that is a view over the first Count elements of this span. The program is ill-formed if Count > Extent. The behavior is undefined if Count > size().

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A span r that is a view over the first Count elements of *this, such that r.data() == this->data() && r.size() == Count.
